**Does this belong in evestack, or upstream in `eve`?**
evestack stays additive to eve — if this is really a change to core agent behavior (tools,
skills, subagents, the durability model), it likely belongs in
[vercel/eve](https://github.com/vercel/eve) instead. If you're not sure, say so and we'll help
figure out where it fits.

**Rough shape of a solution, if you have one**
Not required — "I don't know how, just that it's needed" is a fine issue.
